channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: New York City hotels avert labour strike threat before FIFA World Cup
item.description: Hotel operators avoid a 'very real threat' by signing a deal with 25,000 workers as the city hosts the 2026 tournament.

item.title: WHO says 600 suspected cases, 139 deaths in growing Ebola outbreak
item.description: Numbers are expected to rise, the WHO warns, as European officials emphasise the risk of a European outbreak is low.

item.title: Why are nearly 50,000 Samsung workers about to strike in South Korea?
item.description: Workers' union says protest over bonuses will continue for 18 days.

item.title: US and Israel planned to install Ahmadinejad as Iranian leader, NYT says
item.description: The 'audacious plan' quickly unravelled and Ahmadinejad's whereabouts are unknown, US officials told the newspaper

item.title: Kenya transport strike paused after deadly protests
item.description: Transport operators halt strike over fuel price hikes after several killed and mass arrests.

item.title: Far-right Israeli minister condemned for taunting handcuffed Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: France and Italy are among the countries that have criticised a video showing Itamar Ben-Gvir taunting dozens of activists detained at an Israeli port.

item.title: Ebola vaccine could take nine months as death toll rise further, WHO warns
item.description: In its latest update, the World Health Organization says there have now been 139 suspected deaths and 600 cases.

item.title: Father-of-eight killed in San Diego mosque shooting hailed as hero
item.description: Security guard Amin Abdullah, one of three killed in the attack, was described as "a shining light".
